# Belcotax fixtures

Copied verbatim from SPF Finances' "Exemples fictifs pour les revenus 2026"
(`ExamplesBelcotax2026.zip`, files dated 2026-10-27), published on
<https://finances.belgium.be/fr/E-services/Belcotaxonweb/documentation-technique>.
Fictitious data (SPF's own test identifiers). The JSON files are reformatted by oxfmt;
their content is SPF's. Do not edit it: tests compare the serializer's output
and the client's parsing against these.
